verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a workflow where OpenHands presents an implementation plan for the developer to review and approve before it changes code. The closest items are adjacent: per-action approval implied by the CLI's 'auto-approve all actions' toggle, a pause key, and an SDK guide that uses a planning agent as an example of building custom agents. None of these is a plan-review-and-approve gate, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review and approve an agent's implementation plan before any code changes are made
